name: MultiOrdersExpert
summary: This EA is a thin wrapper that includes multi.mq5 and delegates all event handlers (OnInit, OnDeinit, OnTick, OnChartEvent) to the included file. It contains no trading logic of its own and acts purely as an entry point for the multi.mq5 module, which likely provides a multi-order management panel or utility interface.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个轻量级封装文件，通过#include引入multi.mq5并将所有事件处理函数（初始化、反初始化、Tick、图表事件）直接委托给该模块。它本身不包含任何交易逻辑，仅作为multi.mq5模块的入口点，后者很可能提供多订单管理面板或工具界面。
strategy_analysis: 该EA本身不包含任何交易策略，它只是一个委托层，将所有核心功能转发给multi.mq5文件。从文件名'MultiOrdersExpert'和引用的'multi.mq5'来看，这很可能是一个多订单管理工具，用于批量下单、修改或关闭多个订单。由于所有事件处理函数都直接调用同名函数，这是一种简单的模块化设计模式，将逻辑与入口点分离。入场条件和出场条件完全取决于multi.mq5的实现，当前文件无法判断。仓位管理和资金管理同样由被引用的模块决定。这种架构的风险在于递归调用——如果multi.mq5中也有同名函数调用自身，将导致无限递归和堆栈溢出崩溃。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA contains no trading strategy of its own; it is purely a delegation layer that forwards all core functionality to the multi.mq5 file. Based on the filename 'MultiOrdersExpert' and the included 'multi.mq5', this is most likely a multi-order management utility for batch placing, modifying, or closing multiple orders. Since all event handlers directly call identically-named functions, this is a simple modular design pattern separating logic from the entry point. Entry and exit conditions are entirely dependent on the multi.mq5 implementation and cannot be determined from this file alone. Position sizing and money management are likewise decided by the referenced module. A critical architectural risk is recursive calling — if multi.mq5 also has identically-named functions that call themselves, it will cause infinite recursion and a stack overflow crash.

pros: 模块化设计，将入口点与核心逻辑分离
代码简洁明了，易于理解和维护
支持完整的MQL5事件处理（Tick、图表事件等）

pros_en: Modular design separating entry point from core logic
Clean and minimal code that is easy to understand and maintain
Supports full MQL5 event handling (Tick, ChartEvent, etc.)
Logic reuse enabled through the include mechanism
cons: 严重的递归调用风险：同名函数OnInit/OnDeinit/OnTick/OnChartEvent在include后会与自身冲突，导致无限递归和堆栈溢出
无任何自有逻辑，完全依赖外部文件multi.mq5
无输入参数定义，灵活性极低
缺少错误处理和返回值检查
无法独立运行，若multi.mq5缺失则编译失败
cons_en: Critical recursive call risk: identically-named functions OnInit/OnDeinit/OnTick/OnChartEvent will conflict with themselves after inclusion, causing infinite recursion and stack overflow
Contains no proprietary logic, entirely dependent on the external multi.mq5 file
No input parameters defined, extremely low flexibility
Missing error handling and return value checks
Cannot run independently; compilation fails if multi.mq5 is absent
improvements: 重命名委托函数以避免与multi.mq5中同名函数的递归冲突，例如使用命名空间或前缀
添加输入参数以配置multi.mq5模块的行为，增强灵活性
增加对multi.mq5是否存在的检查和错误处理机制
improvements_en: Rename delegation functions to avoid recursive conflicts with identically-named functions in multi.mq5, e.g. using namespaces or prefixes
Add input parameters to configure the behavior of the multi.mq5 module for greater flexibility
Add existence checks and error handling for the multi.mq5 dependency

risk_points: 同名函数递归调用风险：#include后OnInit等函数在调用自身时会形成无限递归，导致EA崩溃
完全依赖外部文件multi.mq5，若该文件有问题则所有功能失效
无任何风控逻辑可见，订单管理工具若缺乏保护机制可能导致批量误操作
risk_points_en: Recursive function call risk: after #include, functions like OnInit calling themselves form infinite recursion leading to EA crash
Complete dependency on external multi.mq5 file; any issue in that file disables all functionality
No visible risk control logic; an order management tool without safeguards could cause batch misoperations
